cards.card_text: God also wants plates, dishes, pitchers and bowls for the table, all of pure gold.
cards.verse_text: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings.
cards.snippet: …are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings.

cards.card_text: Plates and bowls and pitchers Bells and chains and pomegranates Censers and snuffers and tongs
cards.verse_text: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.
cards.snippet: …pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.

cards.card_text: Then the Teacher says to remember Him before four things: the silver cord, the golden bowl, the pitcher at the spring and the wheel at the well.
cards.verse_text: Remember Him before the silver cord is snapped and the golden bowl is crushed, before the pitcher is shattered at the spring and the wheel is broken at the well,

cards.card_text: Jeremiah sets pitchers full of wine and some cups in front of the Rechabite men and tells them, "Drink some wine." They answer, "We do not drink wine," and they bring up their forefather Jonadab son of Rechab.
cards.verse_text: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites, and I said to them, “Drink some wine.” “We do not drink wine,” they replied, “for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘Neither you nor your descendants are ever to drink wine.
cards.snippet: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house…

cards.card_text: And they have many other traditions, like washing cups, pitchers, kettles and even couches for dining.
cards.verse_text: And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
cards.snippet: …many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
